problem: Find earlier firsthand answers in a long conversation even when the user later gives a conflicting report. On the eight exposed static cases, a reference-guided diagnostic found at least one plausible early report for every designated answer. No reference terms or personalized rules are available to any serving program.
data: Reuse all 24 development requests of memconflict_witness across eight personas and the exact same dialogue cutoff, dates and blinded category-specific full-credit assessment. The 16 reserved personas stay sealed until a promoted implementation is locked. Never read profiles, reference values, categories or synthetic episode annotations in the retrieval or generation programs.
hypothesis: At query time score an individual firsthand report by how much removing its proposed answer span reduces the model’s conditional probability of that span. An intervention restricted to the recurrent matrix can isolate memory attributable to the missing phrase while preserving the ordinary full-evidence attention and convolution state. Rank the delta alongside ordinary answerability, then present dated early and late independent witnesses to the reader.
retrieval: Index actual user utterances through the query session. Generate, from just the question, a one-line vocabulary of possible surface forms and a reader-facing second-person question. Search original and expanded BM25 plus dense Contriever on the bounded lexical pool, existing candidates, and candidates from each chronological quarter. RoBERTa-SQuAD2 extracts an unlabeled candidate answer span and null-calibrated answerability. Pass the 12 strongest plus up to two additional high-scoring per chronological quarter to the causal reranker. Each answer prompt receives at most eight retrieved user reports plus the two-sentence current-session summary represented by first and last actual user utterances; restore chronological order. No previous graded answer is provided.
comparators: Previous strongest full reader 12/24. New baselines: ordinary reciprocal lexical/dense ranking; original RoBERTa span logit ranking; span-ranked chronological coverage; same span-and-chronology system with unmasked LM likelihood; otherwise identical whole-cache masking. Feed all arms to Qwen3.5-4B with the same conflict-aware prompt. Report additional conventional improvements in their own right and keep the strongest even if recurrent attribution adds nothing.
policy: Chronological coverage reserves the two best reports per quarter then fills any empty spots from global order. Combine the three score families using reciprocal ranks at fixed constant 8: RoBERTa span confidence, unmasked answer-token likelihood, and whole-cache or recurrent-only removal gain as applicable. Include a full-state gain arm and a recurrent-only gain arm. The extractive candidate always comes from the real user report, is evaluated teacher-forced with the same question, and cannot contain a gold answer supplied from the annotation.
gates: For a new conventional development winner to count as progress, require >=3 more fully correct than the old 12/24 and mean >=0.5625. To promote the recurrent candidate, require >=3 further full answers over the strongest conventional or whole-state method, mean at least as high and an identical-input no-effect check. Promote the strongest simple method separately if it meets its own gate. Record per-category accuracy and paired persona intervals. Freeze finalists, include both strongest text and matched causal controls, then test on 16 disjoint personas with three questions each. Only a lower paired 95% bound above zero and at least 10 percentage points vs strongest applicable comparator permit a generalization claim.
resource: Per development phase: query formulation 5 minutes; retrieval 15 minutes; support scoring 40 minutes and free generation 20 minutes. Local only, one engineering repair per phase. Log model positions, component timings and elapsed time. Shared computation in this pilot prevents attributing shared wall time to a deployed method. Only an independently timed deployment comparison can establish the cost target.
